attacker_pocs.name: pe-short-resource-frame
attacker_pocs.why: A PE font resource advertises a frame shorter than its embedded FNT file size. The patched extraction accepts the short frame, then family-name copying uses the longer header size and reads past the supplied input buffer.

role_a_rationale: The PE resource loops use wider indices so a total above 65535 terminates instead of wrapping. The frame extraction cap appears to respect the resource size and preserves ordinary fonts, but a short resource leaves later header-sized reads beyond the frame. The parent rejects the PoC before those reads.
